item.text:
**1B.4 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **limited, mostly conditional** evidence of willingness to negotiate with the IAEA and to cap some sensitive material, but **stronger evidence of non-cooperation** on inspections and verification. On balance, 2024 does **not** show clear good-faith support by Khamenei for arms-control or nonproliferation agreements.

**Accepted claims**

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Iran and IAEA will continue talks aimed at ending impasse, Grossi says` | Reuters | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After a visit to Iran, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This supports that the diplomatic channel on verification remained open, but it is only indirect evidence of Khamenei’s good-faith support, not proof of it. | `1B.4` |
| `Iran tells IAEA chief it will negotiate but not under pressure` | Reuters | 2024-11-14 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-tells-iaea-chief-it-is-ready-to-negotiate-but-not-under-pressure-x-3722215) | Iran said it was willing to resolve outstanding nuclear disputes, but only without coercive pressure. This is a weak positive sign for negotiation, though the framing is tactical and conditional rather than a clear endorsement of arms-control in good faith. | `1B.4` |
| `IAEA's Grossi hopes Iran's capping of highly enriched uranium stock holds` | Reuters | 2024-11-20 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iaeas-grossi-hopes-irans-capping-of-highly-enriched-uranium-stock-holds-3732615) | Reuters reported that Iran moved toward capping its stock of uranium just short of weapons grade, and that the IAEA chief hoped the step would hold. This is the best 2024 evidence of a concrete restraint measure, but it was conditional and not yet a durable agreement. | `1B.4` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to step up cooperation and reverse its barring of inspectors; Reuters said Iran had removed many experienced inspectors. This is strong evidence against good-faith support for verification and inspection arrangements. | `1B.4` |
| `IAEA Board passes Iran resolution as West pushes Tehran towards talks` | Reuters | 2024-11-21 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-iran-resolution-as-west-pushes-tehran-towards-talks-3736230) | The Board again ordered Iran to urgently improve cooperation and pressed for a comprehensive report to drive new nuclear talks. This reinforces that Iran’s cooperation remained incomplete and contested late in 2024. | `1B.4` |

**Assessment**

- The **positive** evidence is real but narrow: Iran signaled willingness to negotiate, and there was a conditional move to cap highly enriched uranium.
- The **negative** evidence is stronger: inspectors were barred, the IAEA Board formally demanded improved cooperation, and verification problems persisted through late 2024.
- I found **no direct 2024 evidence** that Khamenei personally and openly backed a durable arms-control, disarmament, or de-escalation agreement in good faith.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a 2024 primary-source statement from Khamenei himself endorsing a new nonproliferation or disarmament accord.
- The available “pro-agreement” evidence is mostly **mediated through Reuters/IAEA** and is **conditional** on pressure or censure dynamics, which makes it weaker than a straightforward good-faith commitment.
